title: Meet your echo
summary: A new page on the death screen shows the echo you left behind: how it looks, the personality your play gave it, how quickly it reacts, and the gear it carries.
highlights: Your echo's personality and traits, shaped by how you played
A skill chart of how quick you were at melee, ranged, blocking, placing, movement and quickswap
Look through the gear your echo carries, item by item

title.zh: 地牢列车 更新：认识你的回响 | 我的世界模组
title.en: Dungeon Train Update: Meet Your Echo | Minecraft Mod

description.zh:
每一次死亡，你都会留下一个回响。
现在，死亡界面新增了一页，让你看清你留下的是谁。

它长什么样、你的玩法给了它怎样的性格、它反应有多快，以及它身上带着什么装备，一目了然。

更新亮点：
· 回响的性格和特质，由你的玩法塑造
· 技能图表展示你在近战、远程、格挡、放置、移动和快速切换上有多快
· 逐件查看回响携带的装备

完整更新说明：dungeon.training/update
下载：在 CurseForge 或 Modrinth 搜索 Dungeon Train
地牢列车是一个 Minecraft（我的世界）NeoForge 1.21.1 模组：在一列永不停歇的列车上冒险、搜刮、生存。
description.en:
Every death leaves an echo behind.
Now the death screen has a new page that shows you who you left.

See how it looks, the personality your play gave it, how quickly it reacts, and the gear it carries.

Highlights:
· Your echo's personality and traits, shaped by how you played
· A skill chart of how quick you were at melee, ranged, blocking, placing, movement and quickswap
· Look through the gear your echo carries, item by item

Full notes: dungeon.training/update
Download: search Dungeon Train on CurseForge or Modrinth
Dungeon Train is a Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1 mod: loot, fight and survive aboard a train that never stops.
